tagline.en_US: The official rest-server image provides an authenticated HTTP REST backend for restic clients, with persistent repositories and bcrypt-protected user accounts. It exposes an API, not a browser-based application.

description.en_US: Rest Server is a high-performance HTTP server implementing restic's REST backend API. It enables restic backup clients to transfer and store backup data remotely over HTTP or HTTPS. The server supports append-only mode to prevent modification or deletion of existing backups, as well as private repositories to isolate user data.
